instruction: Send a request silently with curl
output:
curl --silent https://api.example.com/users
[{"id":1,"name":"Alice"}]

instruction: Show verbose output including TLS handshake with curl
output:
curl --verbose https://api.example.com
*   Trying 93.184.216.34:443...
* Connected to api.example.com (93.184.216.34) port 443 (

instruction: Set a connection timeout with curl
output:
curl --connect-timeout 5 https://slow-server.example.com
curl: (28) Connection timed out after 5001 milliseconds

instruction: Set a maximum total transfer time with curl
output:

instruction: Request compressed response with curl
output:
curl --compressed https://api.example.com/large-data
HTTP/2 200
[{"id":1,"data":"...large payload..."}]

instruction: Follow HTTP redirects with curl
output:
curl --location http://example.com
HTTP/1.1 301 Moved Permanently
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Content-Type: text/html

<!doctype html>...

instruction: Follow redirects for POST to GET (303) with curl
output:
curl --location --post303 --data "submitted=true" https://api.example.com/form
HTTP/1.1 303 See Other
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
{"result":"form processed"}

instruction: Follow redirects preserving POST method (301) with curl
output:
curl --location --post301 --data "action=process" https://api.example.com/action
HTTP/1.1 301 Moved Permanently
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
{"result":"processed"}

content-length: 256
